page_title: ARS 1-1 BHA | Arsenal v Brighton 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Chris Kavanagh is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' The main referee, Chris Kavanagh, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Joao Pedro (Brighton) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+4' David Raya (Arsenal) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
90+2' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) picks up a long through ball, but Bart Verbruggen deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
88' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
87' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
85' A substitution has been made. Danny Welbeck goes off and Julio Enciso (Brighton) comes on.
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kaoru Mitoma walks off the pitch to be replaced by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
83' The ball goes behind for a corner. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is being substituted because of an injury. Mikel Arteta sends Oleksandr Zinchenko on the pitch.
79' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.

76' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. David Raya has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
75' Great save! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Bart Verbruggen.
74' Substitution. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) on for Martin Odegaard.
72' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Georginio Rutter (Brighton) replaces Yankuba Minteh.
72' Here comes a substitution. Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Joel Veltman.
70' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
70' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
69' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) sends in a poor cross from the corner and David Raya has no trouble gathering it.
69' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
67' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
65' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
64' Brighton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
64' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
61' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
59' Substitution. Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Leandro Trossard walks off.
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
57' The ball has crossed the sideline. Arsenal are taking a throw-in.
55' Brighton are ruled offside.
53' Joel Veltman (Brighton) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
52' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' It's the second caution for Declan Rice (Arsenal) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Chris Kavanagh.
47' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Gabriel (Arsenal) sends a wild header high over the bar.
47' Declan Rice (Arsenal) prepares to take a corner kick.

47' Declan Rice (Arsenal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+2' A snap shot by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen produces a good save to thwart him.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
44' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and signals a foul after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to Brighton.
42' Declan Rice (Arsenal) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 1:0.
38' Dangerous play by Gabriel (Arsenal). Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton earn a free kick.
36' One of the players from Arsenal times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
34' Ben White (Arsenal) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
31' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
31' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
29' The corner by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
28' Joao Pedro (Brighton) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
27' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
25' The ball is cleared after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
22' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
17' Problems for Fabian Hurzeler as James Milner is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Yasin Ayari (Brighton) replaces him.
16' The game is interrupted now, James Milner (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' David Raya makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) after a cross from the side.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
12' Surely that's handball by one of the Brighton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt only went low to the middle of the goal, so Bart Verbruggen stops it easily.
8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
6' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
5' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

3' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
2' A pass into the penalty area from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is intercepted by the defence.
1' The match has just started.
Brighton will kick the game off.
Chris Kavanagh is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
